dialogues.speaker: Lugovskoy
dialogues.text: Ah... The bond between caregiver and creature isn't that simple, little one. In the eyes of many, I am the one who raises this beast...

dialogues.speaker: Lugovskoy
dialogues.text: But perhaps to him, he is the one looking after me... After all, when dealing with scoundrels, he proves far more reliable than any hound.
